title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts — Repeat Wrong-Address Surcharge
content:
A shopper who has handed orders to the wrong address before carries a repeat-address surcharge on a new wrong-address violation under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts.

**Clause.** The repeat-address surcharge counts the other wrong-address violations recorded on the account less than twelve whole months before the day the wrong-address violation is booked: 2 or more add 2 points; exactly one adds 1 point; none adds nothing.

## Ladder

| Other wrong-address violations in the twelve months before booking | Repeat-address surcharge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 points |
| Exactly 1 | 1 point |
| None | Nothing |

Only wrong-address violations count toward this surcharge; violations of other types do not. The violation being booked is not one of the "other" violations.

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- One wrong-address violation five months ago: 1 point.
- Two wrong-address violations, three and nine months ago: 2 points.
- One wrong-address violation fourteen months ago: outside the twelve months — nothing.
